title: BiggerPockets vs Rich Dad
keyLine: One is a toolbox. One is a story. Buy the one that matches the week you are in.
description: A side-by-side of BiggerPockets and Rich Dad: format, public prices, who each fits, and what to do after the book. Written by Legacy Investing Show.
answer: BiggerPockets is a real estate community with free podcasts and a paid Pro plan for tools. Rich Dad is a brand around Robert Kiyosaki's book and later classes. Use Rich Dad when you still think a paycheck is the only path. Use BiggerPockets when you are ready to study a real listing. Most people need the book once, then a how-to. You rarely need to pay both at once.
criteriaIntro: We compared what each brand publishes about itself, plus public prices we could copy. We did not sit in a paid coaching call for either brand.

blocks.heading: How to pick this month
paragraphs: If you still believe your salary is the only asset you will ever have, read the book. Then stop. Do not buy a stack of Rich Dad sequels until you can explain one local rental in numbers.

If you can already explain cap rate in a sentence (that is yearly net rent divided by price), skip the parable and go to BiggerPockets or a calculator. Try our [rental cash flow tool](/tools/rental-property-cash-flow).
If your problem is a W-2 tax bill, neither brand is the center. Use [tax strategies for high-income earners](/tax-strategies/for/high-income-earners).

blocks.label: We sell a third thing
paragraphs: Legacy Wealth Blueprint is not a BiggerPockets killer and not a Rich Dad sequel. It is a written plan plus a year of coaching. Use it only if you want tax, debt, and investing in one order. See [Legacy Wealth Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint).

whoFits: You are choosing between a mindset book and an investor community.
You want a clean answer in one screen before you spend.
whoSkips: You already use BiggerPockets weekly and finished the book years ago. You need a different comparison, such as [coaching vs a course](/compare/real-estate-coaching-vs-course).
You want us to declare a moral winner. We will not.

faqs.q: Which one is better for beginners?
faqs.a: The book is the easier first night. BiggerPockets is the better second month. Paying either brand before you use the free layer is usually a waste.
Yes. Read the book once. Then use BiggerPockets for models and math. You do not need two paid memberships to do that.

faqs.q: Does either one file my taxes?
faqs.a: No. See [tax course vs a CPA](/compare/tax-course-vs-cpa).
